title: Know your trade ticket

shots.caption: Prepare a paper trade before acting.
shots.narration: Prepare a paper trade before acting.

shots.caption: Open Trade. Check the instrument.
shots.narration: Open Trade, and check the instrument you are viewing.

shots.caption: Choose Buy or Sell deliberately.
shots.narration: Choose Buy or Sell deliberately. We will use Buy.

shots.caption: Check the order type.
shots.narration: Check the order type. This example uses Market.

shots.caption: Set the lot size.
shots.narration: Set the lot size. This is an illustrative practice account.

shots.caption: Set a stop-loss level.
shots.narration: Enable Stop Loss, then enter your exercise's stop level.

shots.caption: Set a take-profit level.
shots.narration: Enable Take Profit, then enter your exercise's target.

shots.caption: Review the estimated loss and margin.
shots.focus: Enlarged metrics; no motion while reading
shots.narration: Pause to review the estimated loss and margin.

shots.caption: Smaller size changes the loss estimate.
shots.narration: Reduce the lot size, and check how the estimate changes.

shots.caption: Recheck direction, size, stop and target.
shots.narration: Recheck direction, size, stop and target. These are estimates.

shots.caption: Prepared only. No order submitted.
shots.narration: Stop here with the prepared ticket. No order was submitted.

transcript: Prepare a paper trade before acting. Open Trade, and check the instrument you are viewing. Choose Buy or Sell deliberately. We will use Buy. Check the order type. Pause to review the estimated loss and margin. Reduce the lot size, and check how the estimate changes. Recheck direction, size, stop and target. These are estimates. shots.caption: Check its direction.

title: Turn a close into a review

shots.action: Establish an illustrative already-closed paper example
shots.caption: Turn one result into a lesson.
shots.narration: Turn one paper result into a useful learning reflection.

shots.caption: Open Journal beneath the chart.
shots.narration: After a practice close, open Journal beneath the chart.

shots.caption: Read the latest close.
shots.narration: Start with the newest close at the top.

shots.caption: Check direction and instrument together.
shots.narration: Read the trade direction and instrument together.

shots.caption: Check how much was closed.
shots.narration: Check the volume that was closed.

shots.caption: Paper profit alone proves little.
shots.narration: Then read the paper result. Profit alone proves little.

shots.caption: Partial closes can create separate entries.
shots.focus: Mark as illustrative, not extra full trades
shots.narration: A partial close can create another row for one position.

title: What Oracle’s percentage means

shots.action: Introduce Oracle with practice example label
shots.caption: What does Oracle’s percentage actually mean?
shots.narration: Understand Oracle's percentage before using it.

shots.caption: Open Oracle for this chart.
shots.narration: Open Oracle for the chart you are reviewing.

shots.caption: Eight of nine checks passed.
shots.narration: In this example, eight of the nine checks pass.

shots.action: Show calculation to nearest whole percent
shots.caption: Eight divided by nine is about 89%.
shots.narration: Eight divided by nine rounds to eighty-nine percent.

shots.caption: Confluence counts conditions that agree.
shots.narration: This is confluence: a count of conditions that agree.

shots.caption: It is not a win probability.
shots.narration: It is not the probability that a trade will win.

shots.caption: Oracle and ARIA share these checks.
shots.narration: Oracle and Aria use the same checks, so they are not independent confirmations.

shots.caption: Fewer checks agree in this example.
shots.narration: In another example, only six of nine checks agree.

shots.caption: Skip this setup. Keep reviewing.
shots.subnote: Read the failed conditions before proceeding
shots.narration: Read the reasons. Aria says waiting, so leave Apply unused.

shots.caption: Tools prepare. You review and decide.
shots.narration: Tools help you prepare. Review the evidence, and decide with care.
